sentences.en: So when he asked me if
sentences.zh: 所以当他问我

sentences.zh: 西南偏南大会是否会被取消时，我告诉他我不知道。

sentences.en: The Surgeon General had started asking the public not to hoard surgical masks, and just that morning, Los Angeles had declared a state of emergency.
sentences.zh: 卫生局局长已经开始要求公众不要囤积医用口罩，就在那天早上，洛杉矶宣布进入紧急状态。

sentences.en: You don't think we will be going to Cannes?
sentences.zh: “你不认为我们会去戛纳吗？”

sentences.en: Kilmer asked.
sentences.zh: 基默问道。

sentences.en: How about the Olympics?
sentences.zh: “奥运会呢？”

sentences.zh: 奥运会除了在世界大战期间，从未被取消过。

sentences.zh: 你不能取消世界，对吧？

sentences.zh: 坏事会发生，但你仍然需要艺术。

sentences.en: And I thought, right?
sentences.zh: 我想，对吧？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: You still need art.
sentences.zh: 你仍然需要艺术。

sentences.zh: 你仍然需要前进的动力。

sentences.en: You still need to believe that all your effort wasn't for nothing, that we could, we will survive a dark moment in history, and that when that happens, we won't be left without the
sentences.zh: 你仍然需要相信你所有的努力并非徒劳，我们能够、我们将会度过历史上的黑暗时刻，当那一刻到来时，我们不会失去那些

sentences.en: things that made those moments decipherable and meaningful and therefore tolerable.
sentences.zh: 让这些时刻变得可解读、有意义，从而可以忍受的东西。

sentences.en: The world outside had seemed to be getting so, so bad for so, so long, and this was the first whiff of overarching
sentences.zh: 外面的世界似乎已经变得如此糟糕，持续了这么久，而这是我所见过的第一丝笼罩性的

sentences.en: hope and positivity that I'd witnessed in, I couldn't remember how many months or years now.
sentences.zh: 希望和积极的气息，我不记得这是多少个月或多少年来的第一次了。

sentences.en: So much so that I almost couldn't identify it when I saw it.
sentences.zh: 以至于我看到它时几乎无法辨认出来。

sentences.en: The last glowing embers of hope coming from Val Kilmer?
sentences.zh: 最后那点希望的余烬竟然来自方·基默？

sentences.en: The movie hunk of my youth who disappeared unceremoniously and now presented with an entirely different appearance and a bizarre accounting of where he'd been?
sentences.zh: 那个我青春时代的电影帅哥，他悄无声息地消失了，现在却以一种完全不同的外表和对他去向的离奇解释出现在我面前？

sentences.en: But there was something familiar about it, like a faint knocking that came from inside me.
sentences.zh: 但它有一种熟悉的感觉，就像内心深处传来的微弱敲门声。

sentences.en: It was the special kind of optimism that maybe only the faithful have, the enduring belief that some force will come along and save us from the
sentences.zh: 这是一种或许只有信仰者才有的特殊乐观主义，一种持久的信念，相信某种力量会出现，将我们从

sentences.en: centrifuge of despair we found ourselves in.
sentences.zh: 我们所处的绝望离心机中拯救出来。

sentences.en: When is the last time you saw that up close?
sentences.zh: 你上次近距离看到这种东西是什么时候？

sentences.en: Before you can understand the story of what happened to Val Kilmer, you have to determine for yourself who he was in the first place.
sentences.zh: 在你理解方·基默身上发生了什么的故事之前，你必须先自己确定他到底是谁。

sentences.en: Trying to compare him to any movie star working either now or then will fry your mental circuit board.
sentences.zh: 试图将他与现在或当时工作的任何电影明星进行比较，都会烧坏你的大脑电路。

sentences.en: He was an upwardly mobile conventional movie star.
sentences.zh: 他是一位积极进取的传统电影明星。

sentences.en: He was equally a fringe weirdo who would soon disappear.
sentences.zh: 他同样是一个很快就会消失的边缘怪人。

sentences.en: His first movie, Top Secret, 1984, about a rock star in East Berlin, was the follow-up to
sentences.zh: 他的第一部电影《最高机密》，1984年，关于东柏林的一位摇滚明星，是其创意团队继

sentences.en: Airplane by its creative team.
sentences.zh: 《空前绝后满天飞》之后的后续作品。

sentences.en: And it was so funny and such a strange thing to see this extraordinarily handsome young kid, a jaw like the sharp cut bottom half of a stop sign, that true Swede golden hair,
sentences.zh: 而且看到这个格外英俊的年轻人真是太有趣、太奇怪了，他的下巴像停车标志下半部分的锐角切割，那头真正的瑞典金发，

sentences.en: a Cupid's bow that lays in shadow of the plump convex swoop of his upper lip, who also seemed to be in on the joke.
sentences.zh: 他上唇那丰满凸起的弧度下，藏着一个丘比特之弓，他似乎也深谙其中的玩笑。

sentences.en: The 80s were a time when a handsome young man with blonde hair was mostly the butt of it.
sentences.zh: 80年代，一个金发帅哥往往是这类玩笑的嘲弄对象。

sentences.en: He'd been on the road to something slightly more, say, classical when he was at Juilliard.
sentences.zh: 在茱莉亚学院时，他本已走上一条更偏向古典表演的道路。

sentences.en: He starred in Orestes and in The Wood Demon.
sentences.zh: 他主演了《奥瑞斯提亚》和《林中恶魔》。

sentences.en: He wrote a play with his classmates called How It All Began, which went on to run for a month at the public theater after Joe Papp himself saw it at the school.
sentences.zh: 他和同学一起写了一部名为《一切的开端》的剧本，在乔·帕普本人亲自到校观看后，该剧在公共剧院上演了一个月。

sentences.en: He starred in Slab Boys with Sean Penn and Kevin Bacon.
sentences.zh: 他与西恩·潘和凯文·贝肯共同主演了《石板男孩》。

sentences.en: He did As You Like It in
sentences.zh: 他在明尼阿波利斯与帕蒂·卢波恩合作了

sentences.en: Minneapolis with Patti LuPone.
sentences.zh: 《皆大欢喜》。

sentences.en: But once Hollywood got a look at him, he was on too fast a conveyor belt to safely step off.
sentences.zh: 但一旦好莱坞看中了他，他就被推上了一条无法安全退出的快车道。

sentences.en: The success of Top Secret begat a somewhat starring role in Real Genius, meaning that his Chris Knight, the apathetic, irresistible prodigy who helps something laser,
sentences.zh: 《最高机密》的成功催生了他在《天才反击》中某种意义上的主演角色，这意味着他饰演的克里斯·奈特——那个冷漠、不可抗拒、协助制造激光、

sentences.en: chemical, transmitter, radio, something, is the guy on the poster, but he's not the character with the clearest narrative arc.
sentences.zh: 化学、发射器、无线电之类的天才——虽然是海报上的主角，但他并不是叙事弧线最清晰的角色。

sentences.en: He's more of a wise fool in the Shakespeare tradition.
sentences.zh: 他更像是莎士比亚传统中的那种“聪明傻瓜”。

sentences.en: Another hit.
sentences.zh: 又一部热门作品。

sentences.en: Then, in 1986, came Top Gun.
sentences.zh: 然后，1986年，《壮志凌云》上映了。

sentences.en: And after that, everyone knew who Val Kilmer was.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，所有人都认识了方·基默。

sentences.en: Because how could you not?
sentences.zh: 因为怎么可能不认识呢？

sentences.en: But Iceman, the fighter pilot Tom Cruise's Maverick is trying to best for the best of the best of the best position, has maybe 17 words in the whole movie.
sentences.zh: 但“冰人”——那个汤姆·克鲁斯饰演的“独行侠”试图在争夺“精英中的精英”位置时超越的对象——在整部电影里可能只有17句台词。

sentences.en: But it is there that you can see Val Kilmer's greatest gift, which is to make something out of nothing.
sentences.zh: 但正是在那里，你可以看到方·基默的天赋所在，那就是化腐朽为神奇。

sentences.en: To breathe real life into a character who was only there to set the volleyball so that Maverick could spike it.
sentences.zh: 为这样一个仅仅是为了给“独行侠”扣杀而垫球的角色注入真实的生命。

sentences.en: If you asked me then what beguiled me about Val Kilmer, I wouldn't have had the words for it.
sentences.zh: 如果你当时问我方·基默有什么让我着迷的地方，我可能说不上来。

sentences.en: Instead, I would have pictured a man without a shirt.
sentences.zh: 相反，我会脑补出一个赤裸上身的男人。

sentences.en: I am still hard-pressed to picture young Val Kilmer in a regular shirt.
sentences.zh: 直到现在，我依然很难想象年轻的方·基默穿着普通衬衫的样子。

sentences.en: But it wasn't his body that stuck with me when the lights came on.
sentences.zh: 但当灯光亮起时，让我念念不忘的并不是他的身材。

sentences.en: No, it was his awesome physicality.
sentences.zh: 不，是他那令人惊叹的肢体语言。

sentences.en: Him spinning that volleyball on his finger.
sentences.zh: 他用手指转动排球的样子。

sentences.en: Him offering the most fraught, 80s, masculinity-soaked condolences ever when Maverick's radar intercept officer, Goose, buys it during a flight exercise.
sentences.zh: 当“独行侠”的雷达拦截官“呆头鹅”在飞行演习中丧生时，他给出的那番最令人揪心、充满80年代男性荷尔蒙的慰问。

sentences.en: There was something in his immense focus and his full-bodied commitment to just plain being in the scene that took my breath away.
sentences.zh: 他那种极度的专注，以及全身心投入到场景中的状态，让我屏息凝神。

sentences.en: I read somewhere that Kilmer was so dedicated to inhabiting the role that he created Team Iceman and Team Maverick factions in the Top Gun movie caSt.
sentences.zh: 我曾在某处读到，基默为了沉浸在角色中，甚至在《壮志凌云》剧组里搞出了“冰人队”和“独行侠队”的派系对立。

sentences.en: What I also remember is Iceman's snapping his gum with his mighty jaw in non-response to Maverick's admitting that, yes, he's dangerous.
sentences.zh: 我还记得“冰人”用他那强有力的下巴咬断口香糖的动作，以此回应“独行侠”承认自己确实很危险。

sentences.en: In that jaw snap, which is my absolute favorite gift to send to people, there's so much more than a weird way to end a conversation.
sentences.zh: 那个咬断口香糖的动作——这是我最喜欢发给别人的表情包——其中蕴含的意义远不止是一种奇怪的结束对话的方式。

sentences.en: It's arrogance and pathos, frustration and whatever the emotion is where you know that laughing at someone will hurt them more than insulting them.
sentences.zh: 那是傲慢与悲怆，是挫败感，以及那种你知道嘲笑某人比侮辱某人更伤人的复杂情绪。

sentences.en: The next few jobs came relatively quickly.
sentences.zh: 接下来的几份工作来得相对较快。

sentences.en: The crazed, greedy, delightful Mad Mardigan in Willow, shouting epithets at the hero of the story with a vitality and electricity that makes you somehow root for him.
sentences.zh: 在《小魔仙》中饰演疯狂、贪婪又迷人的马德马根，他以一种充满活力和电力的姿态对故事主角大喊大叫，让你不知为何竟会支持他。

sentences.en: Kill Me Again, in which he plays a dumb investigator who becomes the mark of a conwoman, played by his wife at the time, Joanne Wally.
sentences.zh: 在《再杀我一次》中，他饰演一名愚蠢的调查员，却成了他当时的妻子乔安妮·威利所饰演的骗子的目标。

sentences.en: The Doors, an Oliver Stone movie made extremely watchable by Kilmer's method performance as Jim
sentences.zh: 在奥利弗·斯通执导的《大门》中，基默通过方法派表演让这部电影极具观赏性，他饰演吉姆·

sentences.en: Morrison, so method-y and deep in the role, it's not so long into any kind of re-watching of that movie
sentences.zh: 莫里森，那种方法派的深度投入，以至于在重温这部电影时，没过多久

sentences.en: that I realize I can no longer remember what real Jim Morrison sounded or looked like.
sentences.zh: 我就意识到自己已经记不清真实的吉姆·莫里森听起来或看起来是什么样了。

sentences.en: Then the beloved tombstone, in which he once again went deep method on the tubercular dentist
sentences.zh: 接着是备受喜爱的《墓碑镇》，他再次深入钻研了那个患有肺结核的牙医

sentences.en: Doc Holliday, sweaty and yellow, gasping for breath through his puffs on his cigarette.
sentences.zh: 多克·霍利迪，他满头大汗、面色蜡黄，在抽烟时气喘吁吁。

sentences.en: It was around this time that both Kilmer and his viewing public ran into a problem.
sentences.zh: 就在这个时候，基默和他的观众都遇到了一个问题。

sentences.en: If you're good at acting, and you're super hunky, and you look good with your shirt off, and also are willing to take it off, you are an excellent candidate for a promotion.
sentences.zh: 如果你演技好，又超级帅，脱了衣服好看，而且还愿意脱，那你就是晋升的绝佳人选。

sentences.en: And so Val Kilmer leveled up.
sentences.zh: 于是，方·基默升级了。

sentences.en: Pretty soon, he was cast as pure leads of what were, or were designed to be, blockbusters.
sentences.zh: 很快，他开始在那些本就是、或旨在成为大片的电影中担任纯粹的主角。

sentences.en: Batman Forever, The Island of Dr. Moreau, The Saint.
sentences.zh: 《永远的蝙蝠侠》、《人魔岛》、《圣徒》。

sentences.en: He didn't do badly in any of those roles, exactly.
sentences.zh: 他在这些角色中表现得并不算差。

sentences.en: It's more as if all the elements were there, but they couldn't unite to make a real person.
sentences.zh: 更像是所有元素都齐备了，却无法融合出一个真实的人。

sentences.en: The whole was less than the sum of its parts.
sentences.zh: 整体效果反而不如各部分之和。

sentences.en: His Jack Andrews in Kill Me Again is supposed to be some kind of everyman, but he's really the absence of a person, a body without a soul.
sentences.zh: 他在《再杀我一次》中的杰克·安德鲁斯本应是个普通人，但他实际上是一个人的缺失，一个没有灵魂的躯壳。

sentences.en: In Thunderheart,
sentences.zh: 在《雷霆之心》中，

sentences.zh: 基默饰演一名有印第安血统的普通FBI探员，我实在看不下去剩下的部分。在《永远的蝙蝠侠》中，他的面部几乎没有任何表情。

sentences.en: And, well, here were the reviews.
sentences.zh: 然后，评论来了。

sentences.en: Janet Maslin in this newspaper said Kilmer was hamstrung by the straight man aspects of the role, while Roger Ebert raved that he was completely acceptable.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的珍妮特·马斯林说基默被角色中“直男”的一面束缚住了，而罗杰·伊伯特则盛赞他表现得完全合格。

sentences.en: There came reports of problems on sets, that he was complaining constantly and making impossible demands, that he was rude to his co-stars and stayed in character
sentences.zh: 有报道称他在片场有问题，他不断抱怨并提出无理要求，对合作演员粗鲁无礼，并且一直保持着角色状态，

sentences.en: all the time, never bothering with even small courtesies to the other people on set, that he fought with Oliver Stone about glorifying substance abuse
sentences.zh: 从不顾及片场其他人的基本礼貌，他还因为美化药物滥用问题与奥利弗·斯通争吵，

sentences.en: in a movie that was literally about Jim Morrison.
sentences.zh: 而那部电影讲的正是吉姆·莫里森。

sentences.en: That Kilmer, committed to the method even through casting, became too aggressive with a woman during an audition in front of Stone and the casting
sentences.zh: 还有报道称，基默在选角时也沉浸在方法派表演中，在斯通和选角

sentences.en: director as he became swept up in an emotionally charged moment.
sentences.zh: 导演面前，因为陷入情绪激动的时刻而对一名女性表现得过于激进。

sentences.en: The incident resulted in a settlement, though he maintains it was the actress who attacked him, and the casting director has said that
sentences.zh: 该事件最终达成和解，尽管他坚称是女演员先攻击他，而选角导演则表示

sentences.en: both actors were physical with each other in the heat of this moment.
sentences.zh: 两位演员在当时激动的时刻确实都有肢体接触。

sentences.en: Joel Schumacher called him psychotic in an interview after directing him in Batman Forever, whose sequels Kilmer was supposed to star in.
sentences.zh: 乔·舒马赫在执导完《永远的蝙蝠侠》后接受采访时称他有精神病，而基默本应出演该片的续集。

sentences.en: There are several different versions of why George Clooney replaced him.
sentences.zh: 关于乔治·克鲁尼为何取代他，有多种说法。

sentences.en: Kilmer says it was because of scheduling difficulties with the other movie he had a contract for, The Saint, but one factor was surely this assessment by its director.
sentences.zh: 基默说是由于他签约的另一部电影《圣徒》的档期冲突，但导演的评价无疑是一个因素。

sentences.en: Multiple sources have claimed that on the set of The Island of
sentences.zh: 多个消息来源称，在《人魔岛》的片场，

sentences.zh: 基默用点燃的香烟烫伤了一名工作人员的鬓角。

sentences.en: He claims this was an accident that resulted from the cinematographers asking him to blow smoke from off camera very close to where a member of the camera crew was standing.
sentences.zh: 他声称这是一次意外，起因是摄影师要求他在摄像组人员站立的地方附近从镜头外吹烟。

sentences.en: What kind of person would singe a fellow worker he spends 15 hours a day with, often less than a foot apart?
sentences.zh: 什么样的人会去烧伤一个每天相处15小时、距离往往不到一英尺的同事？

sentences.en: Madness.
sentences.zh: 疯了。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在可以了。

sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》App时，你在App里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.

sentences.en: This all begins to explain why it's hard to make sense of who exactly Val Kilmer was.
sentences.zh: 这一切开始解释了为什么很难弄清楚方·基默到底是个什么样的人。

sentences.en: His whole thing is telling stories, but at this point, he didn't yet know which story he was telling.
sentences.zh: 他的全部意义在于讲故事，但在当时，他还没弄清楚自己到底在讲哪个故事。

sentences.en: He can put it all together now far better than he ever could back then.
sentences.zh: 现在的他比过去任何时候都能更好地将这一切串联起来。

sentences.en: He'd had his pick of roles.
sentences.zh: 他曾有挑选角色的权利。

sentences.en: He was being offered lucrative franchises.
sentences.zh: 他曾被提供利润丰厚的系列电影。

sentences.en: His talent was in doubt by absolutely no one.
sentences.zh: 他的才华毋庸置疑。

sentences.en: His gift was both so overt and so subtle that he was the most memorable part of the movies he merely supported.
sentences.zh: 他的天赋既显眼又微妙，以至于他成了那些他仅仅是配角的电影中最令人难忘的部分。

sentences.en: And yet suddenly, he was radioactive.

sentences.zh: 但那家店面当时已经清空，所以里面空无一人，尽管她穿过了玻璃，却毫发无伤。

sentences.en: About a time he was driving to the airport from his ranch and a car wandered through the median and he was going too fast to
sentences.zh: 关于有一次他从牧场开车去机场，一辆车穿过隔离带，而他车速太快无法

sentences.en: stop and so his car went through this other car without colliding with it.
sentences.zh: 停下，于是他的车直接穿过了那辆车，却没有发生碰撞。

sentences.en: He can still see the mole on the driver's neck as he went through him without causing material disturbance to either of their bodies or vehicles.
sentences.zh: 他依然能看到那个司机脖子上的痣，当时他穿过了对方，却没有对他们任何人的身体或车辆造成实质性的破坏。

sentences.en: These things happened because he'd been praying his whole life.
sentences.zh: 这些事情之所以发生，是因为他一生都在祈祷。

sentences.en: But the other thing he'd been doing his whole life was telling these stories, turning the way we are constantly walking along the edge of our imminent demise.
sentences.zh: 但他一生中还在做另一件事，那就是讲述这些故事，扭转我们不断行走在迫在眉睫的死亡边缘的方式。

sentences.en: Sure, imminent if you believe in time, demise if you believe in death, and trying to make sense of what could happen to a person at any given moment.
sentences.zh: 当然，如果你相信时间，那就是迫在眉睫；如果你相信死亡，那就是终结；他试图理解一个人在任何特定时刻可能发生的事情。

sentences.en: A religious person.
sentences.zh: 一个有宗教信仰的人。

sentences.en: A person who is trying to be good in the world.
sentences.zh: 一个试图在这个世界上做一个好人的人。

sentences.en: That his daughter could be hit by a car?
sentences.zh: 他的女儿可能会被车撞？

sentences.en: That he could die on the way to the airport?
sentences.zh: 他可能会在去机场的路上死去？

sentences.en: That his reputation could be shattered?
sentences.zh: 他的名声可能会毁于一旦？

sentences.en: That he could have a hole in his throat?
sentences.zh: 他的喉咙可能会留下一个洞？

sentences.en: Who could blame a person who needed to make sense of the chaotic turns of his life with a story?
sentences.zh: 谁能责怪一个需要用故事来理清生活中混乱转折的人呢？

sentences.en: But even more, what else was he supposed to do?
sentences.zh: 但更重要的是，他还能做什么呢？

sentences.en: When he told me these stories, I told him it was hard for me to imagine that a person could heal themselves or prevent certain disaster with prayer.
sentences.zh: 当他告诉我这些故事时，我告诉他，我很难想象一个人可以通过祈祷来治愈自己或阻止某种灾难。

sentences.en: He said, it's not that difficult.
sentences.zh: 他说，这并不难。

sentences.en: When he said that, I realized that as the days had gone on, it had become easier to understand him.
sentences.zh: 当他说出这句话时，我意识到随着日子一天天过去，理解他变得容易了一些。

sentences.en: The Times was calling for staff members to return to base and begin working from home, so I headed to the airport the next morning with my suitcase
sentences.zh: 《时代》周刊要求员工返回总部并开始居家办公，所以第二天早上我带着行李箱

sentences.en: and my painting, which I promised myself I would mail back to Kilmer when I arrived at home.
sentences.zh: 和那幅画出发去机场，我答应自己回家后会把它寄还给基尔默。

sentences.en: People were wearing masks on my flight and sanitizing the cups of soda they received during in-flight service, and I drifted off to sleep, feeling bad for them.
sentences.zh: 飞机上的人们都戴着口罩，还给机上服务时收到的苏打水杯消毒，我昏昏沉沉地睡去，为他们感到难过。

sentences.en: South by Southwest was canceled before I even landed.
sentences.zh: 我还没落地，西南偏南大会就被取消了。

sentences.en: Cannes was postponed.
sentences.zh: 戛纳电影节被推迟了。

sentences.en: Eventually, the Olympics were too.
sentences.zh: 最终，奥运会也未能幸免。

sentences.en: In the coming weeks, everything was canceled.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周里，一切都被取消了。

sentences.en: School, outside, hugs.
sentences.zh: 学校、户外活动、拥抱。

sentences.en: Peter Beard went missing, and Kilmer took a walk with Ali Alborzi, who was distraught.
sentences.zh: 彼得·比尔德失踪了，基尔默和心烦意乱的阿里·阿尔博齐一起去散步。

sentences.en: It was the longest walk Kilmer had taken in a long time, and he realized that two hummingbirds had been following him, had been following them for three days.
sentences.zh: 那是基尔默很久以来走得最长的一次路，他意识到有两只蜂鸟一直跟着他，跟着他们已经三天了。

sentences.en: Birds have always been a part of my family, Kilmer texted me, being the harbingers of life and the story of death.
sentences.zh: 鸟儿一直是我家庭的一部分，基尔默给我发短信说，它们是生命的先驱，也是死亡故事的见证者。

sentences.en: He believed the hummingbirds had a message for them about Beard.
sentences.zh: 他相信蜂鸟是给他们带来了关于比尔德的消息。

sentences.en: By then, I thought, how beautiful.
sentences.zh: 那时我想，多美啊。

sentences.en: Perhaps we had created the coronavirus out of our fear and wickedness, children in cages, the rich hoarding wealth.
sentences.zh: 也许是我们自己的恐惧和邪恶创造了新冠病毒，比如关在笼子里的孩子，富人囤积财富。

sentences.en: Perhaps we had only the suggestion of a virus.
sentences.zh: 也许我们只是受到了病毒的暗示。

sentences.en: I grew up with too many messianics in my household.
sentences.zh: 我在家里和太多的救世主信徒一起长大。

sentences.en: I found this kind of thing too easy to believe, if only because it was more believable than the fact that in 2020, my young, healthy colleagues were in the hospital.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这种事情太容易相信了，仅仅是因为它比“2020年我年轻健康的同事们竟然住进了医院”这一事实更可信。

sentences.en: The streets were bare, I was stuck inside my house, and nobody knew how long that might go on for.
sentences.zh: 街道空无一人，我被困在家里，没人知道这种情况会持续多久。

sentences.en: For a few days, I stared at my beautiful painting, which I will absolutely return when it's safe to take a non-essential trip to the post office.
sentences.zh: 有几天，我盯着我那幅美丽的画，等去邮局进行非必要出行变得安全时，我一定会把它还回去。

sentences.en: It was so hard to parse all the fear that permeated society now, what was real and what had come as a result of our own hysteria.
sentences.zh: 现在很难分辨弥漫在社会中的所有恐惧，哪些是真实的，哪些是我们自己歇斯底里的结果。

sentences.en: During the day, I'd think that it was the fear that was hurting us moSt. But at night, my husband would shake me to wake me up because I'd been crying in my sleep.
sentences.zh: 白天，我会觉得是恐惧在伤害我们。但到了晚上，我丈夫会摇醒我，因为我在睡梦中哭泣。

sentences.en: More quickly than I could have imagined, the world took on the hallucinogenic quality of right before you fall asleep, when everything is outside, and nothing makes sense.
sentences.zh: 世界比我预想的更快地带上了那种入睡前产生的幻觉感，一切都显得格格不入，毫无逻辑。

sentences.en: The margins on my suspension of disbelief started to close in on themselves, and the borders of things began to diminish.
sentences.zh: 我怀疑的底线开始自我收缩，事物的边界开始模糊。

sentences.en: And now the world seemed like a word you stare at so long that it becomes nonsense.
sentences.zh: 现在世界看起来就像一个你盯着看太久而变得毫无意义的词。

sentences.en: I watched all the Val Kilmer movies again, but this time they struck me as representations of a world that never existed, that couldn't
sentences.zh: 我又看了一遍瓦尔·基尔默所有的电影，但这一次它们让我觉得是一个从未存在过、也不可能

sentences.en: possibly exiSt. What is sweaty, shirtless fighter pilot?
sentences.zh: 存在的世界的写照。什么是满头大汗、赤裸上身的战斗机飞行员？

sentences.en: What is dentist with tuberculosis?
sentences.zh: 什么是患有肺结核的牙医？

sentences.en: What is downtown LA shootout?
sentences.zh: 什么是洛杉矶市中心的枪战？

sentences.en: What is Batmobile?
sentences.zh: 什么是蝙蝠车？

sentences.en: What is Lizard King?
sentences.zh: 什么是蜥蜴之王？

sentences.en: Amid all this, I received a phone call.
sentences.zh: 就在这一切之中，我接到了一个电话。

sentences.en: One of my closest and oldest friends, Lydia, called me to tell me she had throat cancer.
sentences.zh: 我最亲密、最老的朋友之一莉迪亚打电话告诉我，她得了喉癌。

sentences.en: I had seen her a few weeks before, and she told me she had been having bouts of laryngitis, but now she had a diagnosis.
sentences.zh: 几周前我见过她，她告诉我她一直喉炎发作，但现在她确诊了。

sentences.en: It was stage zero.
sentences.zh: 是零期。

sentences.en: It had not yet spread.
sentences.zh: 还没有扩散。

sentences.en: I cried into the phone with her.
sentences.zh: 我在电话里和她一起哭了。

sentences.en: But also, here I was, finding this out while writing an article about a man who had throat cancer.
sentences.zh: 但同时，我竟然是在写一篇关于一个患有喉癌的男人的文章时得知这个消息的。

sentences.en: I called up Kilmer and told him about Lydia.
sentences.zh: 我打电话给基尔默，告诉了他莉迪亚的事。

sentences.en: I asked if he had any advice to give her.
sentences.zh: 我问他有没有什么建议给她。

sentences.en: He did.
sentences.zh: 他有。

sentences.en: Kilmer told me that she could have a healing at any minute.
sentences.zh: 基尔默告诉我，她随时都可能痊愈。

sentences.en: It could happen right now, or when she's on her way to the hospital, or even while a doctor is operating on her.
sentences.zh: 这可能就在现在发生，或者在她去医院的路上，甚至在医生给她做手术时。

sentences.en: I called her and told her this, and it made us both giddy for some reason.
sentences.zh: 我打电话告诉她这些，不知为何，这让我们俩都感到一阵眩晕。

sentences.en: But then, a few days later, her surgery was postponed because of the coronavirus, and we aren't sure, even as of this writing, when it will happen, and now her cancer might spread.
sentences.zh: 但几天后，她的手术因为新冠疫情被推迟了，直到写这篇文章时，我们还不确定手术何时进行，现在她的癌症可能会扩散。

sentences.en: I felt stupid for trying to find meaning and hope in what was happening to Lydia.
sentences.zh: 我为自己试图在莉迪亚身上发生的事情中寻找意义和希望而感到愚蠢。

sentences.en: I felt stupid for trying to make this into a story for her and for us.
sentences.zh: 我为试图把这件事变成一个关于她和我们的故事而感到愚蠢。

sentences.en: In just two weeks, the palm trees against the bright blue sky that hung over
sentences.zh: 仅仅两周时间，悬挂在Helmel上空、映衬着明亮蓝天的棕榈树

sentences.en: Helmel seemed like something I made up, as weird to think about as a Batman figure with a Mark Twain head.
sentences.zh: 看起来就像是我编造出来的东西，就像想到一个长着马克·吐温脑袋的蝙蝠侠人偶一样怪异。

sentences.en: Was that even real?
sentences.zh: 那真的是真实的吗？

sentences.en: I searched my phone and found a picture of it.
sentences.zh: 我搜索了手机，找到了一张照片。

sentences.en: Phew.
sentences.zh: 呼。

sentences.en: By now, I understood that the story I was telling about Val Kilmer, which I'd thought had been about a man's relentless faith and optimism, was really about reconciliation.
sentences.zh: 到现在，我明白了，我讲述的关于瓦尔·基尔默的故事，我原以为是关于一个男人不懈的信念和乐观，其实是关于和解。

sentences.en: The squaring of two opposing things into something we swear is true despite all evidence to the contrary.
sentences.zh: 将两个对立的事物调和成我们坚信为真的东西，尽管所有证据都与之相反。

sentences.en: Your beauty can sentence you to misery.
sentences.zh: 你的美丽可能会让你陷入痛苦。

sentences.en: Val Kilmer uses a tracheostomy tube, but he can talk.
sentences.zh: 瓦尔·基尔默使用气管切开插管，但他可以说话。

sentences.en: His brother is dead, but only to our senses.
sentences.zh: 他的兄弟去世了，但那只是对我们的感官而言。

sentences.en: Mark Twain despised Mary Baker Eddy until you can will him into a dream where he doesn't.
sentences.zh: 马克·吐温鄙视玛丽·贝克·艾迪，直到你可以把他带入一个他不鄙视她的梦境中。

sentences.en: God is good, and there are no ventilators.
sentences.zh: 上帝是仁慈的，没有呼吸机。

sentences.en: My beautiful friend has cancer, and the treatment exists, but it's unavailable to her right now.
sentences.zh: 我美丽的闺蜜得了癌症，治疗方法存在，但她现在无法获得。

sentences.en: Here's the thing.
sentences.zh: 事情是这样的。

sentences.en: Mark Twain,
sentences.zh: 马克·吐温，

sentences.en: Kilmer's favorite storyteller, thought that storytelling couldn't and shouldn't try to capture an entire life, to draw its arc, to determine its meaning.
sentences.zh: 基尔默最喜欢的讲故事的人，认为讲故事不能也不应该试图捕捉整个人生，去勾勒它的弧线，去确定它的意义。

sentences.en: He was suspicious of the kind of autobiography that Ben Franklin had done.
sentences.zh: 他怀疑本·富兰克林那种自传方式。

sentences.en: He thought it should just be a mishmash of remembrances, told not even in the right order, lest a person be tempted to force a story into a certain direction,
sentences.zh: 他认为那应该只是一堆回忆的杂烩，甚至不需要按正确的顺序讲述，以免一个人受到诱惑，强行把故事引向某个方向，

sentences.en: and make themselves a more sympathetic character than they deserve.
sentences.zh: 并把自己塑造成一个比实际更值得同情的角色。

sentences.en: Here's another thing.
sentences.zh: 还有一件事。

sentences.en: I spoke to his daughter, Mercedes, who told me that she did have a miraculous recovery, but that a bone in her
sentences.zh: 我和他的女儿梅赛德斯谈过，她告诉我她确实有过奇迹般的康复，但她脸上的骨头

sentences.en: face had been broken, and that she was in a wheelchair for a month and required major surgery.
sentences.zh: 骨折了，她坐了一个月的轮椅，并接受了大手术。

sentences.en: I spoke to Val Kilmer one more time.
sentences.zh: 我又和瓦尔·基尔默谈了一次。

sentences.en: While we were on the phone, I stared at my painting, the divers diving in over and over.
sentences.zh: 通话时，我盯着我的那幅画，看着潜水员一次又一次地潜入水中。

sentences.en: What is hell, Mel?
sentences.zh: 什么是地狱，梅尔？

sentences.en: What is ocean?
sentences.zh: 什么是海洋？

sentences.en: And I tried to remember how I felt when it was beside me in Los Angeles, in the passenger seat of the rental car.
sentences.zh: 我试图回忆起当它在洛杉矶、在租来的车的副驾驶座上时，我有什么感觉。

sentences.en: Kilmer told me that he and
sentences.zh: 基尔默告诉我，他和

sentences.en: Alborzi were going to get in a car and drive to New Mexico, where he still has 160 acres of land.
sentences.zh: 阿尔博齐打算开车去新墨西哥州，他在那里还有160英亩的土地。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Tom Cruise tweeted that the Top Gun sequel was moving to December, two of my colleagues were in the hospital, and another's husband lay in his bed gasping for breath.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，汤姆·克鲁斯发推文说《壮志凌云》续集推迟到十二月，我的两名同事住进了医院，另一名同事的丈夫躺在床上喘着粗气。

sentences.en: I attended a Zoom shiva for a friend's mother, who was buried alone.
sentences.zh: 我参加了一场线上守丧仪式，是为了朋友的母亲，她被独自安葬了。

sentences.en: Peter Beard lay in the woods, weeks away from being found.
sentences.zh: 彼得·比尔德躺在树林里，距离被发现还有几周时间。

sentences.en: The Val Kilmer gif snapped its jaw over and over forever in a text message.
sentences.zh: 瓦尔·基尔默的动图在短信中永远地一张一合地咬着下巴。

sentences.en: Lydia waited by the phone, though she had not been told to expect a call.
sentences.zh: 莉迪亚守在电话旁，尽管没人告诉她会有电话打来。

sentences.en: And Val Kilmer planned his road trip into the desert.
sentences.zh: 而瓦尔·基尔默计划着他的沙漠公路旅行。

sentences.en: This was recorded by Autumn.
sentences.zh: 这段录音由Autumn提供。

sentences.en: Autumn is an app you can download to listen to lots of audio stories from publishers such as the New York Times.
sentences.zh: Autumn是一款你可以下载的应用程序，用来收听来自《纽约时报》等出版商的大量音频故事。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在我和莎拉·凯尼格主持的最新一期《地铁》节目中，讲述了人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在任何你获取播客的地方收听。
